notes: Runs are headless `claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose` sessions inside a fresh copy of each fixture repo (setup_fixtures.sh). Agent-tool subagents can't be the executor: the skill itself dispatches a background Opus reviewer, which calls /code-review. with_skill sends `prompt` (the slash command); without_skill sends `baseline_prompt`, the same request in plain words, with the Skill tool disallowed. Each run gets its own TMPDIR under the run dir, passed with --add-dir, since sandboxes often block /tmp. Every assertion is checked by grade_runs.py against the fixture's planted ground truth, the run's repo state and its transcript; `check` names the function that grades it.

evals.name: planted-bug
evals.prompt:
/adversarial-review page bounds

Spec: paginate(items, page, size) returns 1-based pages; the last page holds the leftovers, and an empty list has a single empty page. Test command: bun test
evals.baseline_prompt:
Do an adversarial review of my last commit: try to break it, focusing on page bounds.

Spec: paginate(items, page, size) returns 1-based pages; the last page holds the leftovers, and an empty list has a single empty page. Test command: bun test

assertions.text: The review reports that the page count rounds down, so the last partial page can't be reached
The review reports that an empty list has no valid page (paginate([], 1, n) throws)
A bug was demonstrated by running code other than the test suite (a repro script or bun -e)
The review names a test gap: the commit's tests never reach the last page or the upper page bound
The commit under review and the working tree are unchanged: nothing was fixed before the user chose
